# Areas

## `llmlm`

`src/llmlm/__init__.py`

llmlm: the one model-call layer for the lm repos, a library with no command line.

## `llmlm.clock`

`src/llmlm/clock.py`

The one module that reads the wall clock (metalm coding.md, "Module shape": inject `now` wherever time matters). Everything else takes a `clock` (a no-argument callable returning an aware UTC datetime) or a `now`, defaulting to `utc_now`, so a test pins time instead of waiting.
